logline: When the kiln guardian lets the fire die, the wood guardian must carry a half-carved panel across a silent village, and the two learn that their crafts were always one bench.

beats.summary: A-Mu walks the lane and finds the workshop street still dark at first light.

line.en: The street is quieter than it should be.

beats.summary: The kiln door stands cold and open, and A-Mu reads the silence as a refusal.

line.zh: 阿火没有点窑。这不是忘记了。
line.en: A-Huo did not light the kiln. That is not forgetfulness.

beats.summary: A-Huo sits with a cold kiln and a single surviving test tile.

line.zh: 火一停，山上的树就能多活一季。
line.en: If the fire rests, the trees on the mountain live one more season.

beats.summary: A-Huo turns the test tile and sees a crackle no one has fired before.

line.zh: 窑不说话，它用颜色回答。
line.en: The kiln does not argue; it answers in colour.

beats.summary: A-Mu sets down a commissioned panel that needs fire to finish the inlay.

line.zh: 这块板子，没有火就只是木头。
line.en: Without fire this panel is only wood.

beats.summary: The buyer leaves without the commission; A-Mu lets the grain stay unfinished.

line.zh: 量两次，然后让木头保留第二次。
line.en: Measure twice, and let the wood keep the second measure.

beats.summary: A-Huo carries the kiln fire to the wood bench instead of asking for permission.

line.en: I brought the fire. I will not argue.

beats.summary: The two guardians set one bench where carving and glazing share the same surface.

line.en: Then one bench, two pairs of hands.
The fire waits for the wood, the wood waits for the fire.

beats.summary: The first fired panel comes out of the kiln with the wood grain still visible.

line.zh: 纹理还在，颜色也留下了。
line.en: The grain survived, and the colour stayed.

beats.summary: The two guardians teach the finishing step to the village apprentices together.

line.zh: 学的人留下，手艺就留下。
line.en: Keep the student, keep the craft.
